functionalReqs: Hall calls (up/down) and car calls (destination floor)
Dispatcher assigns hall calls to elevators
Elevators move, stop, open and close doors
hints: Each elevator behaves differently when moving up, moving down, idle or in maintenance. Which pattern models that?
Put the choice of elevator for a hall call behind a strategy (nearest car, SCAN/LOOK).

ElevatorController (dispatcher) with a DispatchStrategy; ElevatorCar with State (Idle, MovingUp, MovingDown, Maintenance), two sorted sets of pending stops (up and down); Request, Button, Door, Display; each car runs in its own thread with a thread-safe request queue.
nonFunctionalReqs: Safe concurrent handling of button presses
problemStatement: Design the control system for a building with **multiple elevators**. People press up/down buttons on floors and destination buttons inside cars; a controller decides which elevator serves each request.
title: Design an Elevator System
